evidence_quotes:
HYDRO-BOOST –  Converts hydraulic power from the steering pump to mechanical power to the
master cylinder, providing power assist during braking.
statements.reason: The hydro-boost description states this conversion.
statements.statement: The hydro-boost unit converts hydraulic power from the steering pump to mechanical power to the master cylinder.

statements.reason: The hydro-boost description states this function.
statements.statement: The hydro-boost unit provides power assist during braking.

evidence_quotes:
A defective power steering pump,
gear, hoses, or control valve could
affect hydro-booster operation.
statements.reason: It says a defective pump could affect hydro-booster operation.
statements.statement: The brake guidance identifies the power steering pump as a possible influence on hydro-boost operation.

evidence_quotes:

statements.reason: It says a defective gear could affect hydro-booster operation.

statements.reason: The guidance does not mention a fan drive.
statements.statement: The brake guidance identifies the fan drive as a possible influence on hydro-boost operation.

statements.reason: It identifies hydro-booster operation as what could be affected, not hydro-boosters as an influence.
statements.statement: The brake guidance identifies hydro-boosters as possible influences on hydro-boost operation.
